name: BPSR ReadyAlert
summary: Queue alerts, combat meters and live encounter tracking, with an optional chat overlay.
description: A lightweight Windows companion for Blue Protocol: Star Resonance. Follow your party’s combat, track the current encounter and hear when a queue is ready.
features: DPS, healing and tank meters with encounter history, exports and player inspection.
Live target HP and Enrage timer, dungeon mechanics, Food/Serum and Imagine tracking.
Ready and party alerts, plus a view-only chat overlay with optional translation and text-to-speech.
steps: Install Npcap, then download BPSR-ReadyAlert.exe from the latest release.
Run the app and open BPSR. If capture is empty, choose the correct network adapter in Settings.
Enable the overlays you want. Ctrl+Shift+F10 toggles the DPS and Mechanics overlays.
requirements: 64-bit Windows
Npcap, installed separately
A supported BPSR client
notes: Reads network traffic through Npcap. It does not inject into the game or automate gameplay.
Optional translation and speech use online services. Game or service updates can affect those features.

name: BPSR MIDI Lite / Studio
summary: Play MIDI on BPSR instruments. Studio adds experimental audio-to-MIDI and four-part band arrangements.
description: Play songs on Blue Protocol: Star Resonance instruments, solo or with a band. Use Lite for MIDI playback, or Studio to turn an audio file into an arrangement.
features: Browse local MIDI and Online Sequencer songs, then check notes against your instrument and unlocked category.
Use shared Band Mode playback across Lite and Studio.
Studio accepts local audio and can arrange Piano, Guitar, Bass and Drums for review and export.

variants.name: Lite
variants.purpose: MIDI playback and Band Mode, with the smaller download.

variants.name: Studio · beta
variants.purpose: Lite features plus audio transcription and Audio → Band. Extra models download on first use.

steps: Download your chosen edition from Releases and open its EXE. No separate Python installation is needed.
Select your BPSR instrument and unlocked category, choose a song, then review Song Check.
Press Play and return to the game’s instrument screen before the countdown ends. Press F10 to stop.
requirements: 64-bit Windows and BPSR
Internet for online songs and first-time Studio setup
Additional disk space and processing time for Studio’s models
notes: Playback sends instrument key presses to the game. It does not modify game files.
Studio transcription is experimental. Review the result; dense songs can still contain incorrect or missing notes. Only process audio you have permission to use.

name: BlueMeter Lite
summary: See DPS, healing and damage received in a movable overlay, directly on your phone.
description: An Android combat meter for Blue Protocol: Star Resonance. Keep combat statistics over the game without a PC.
note: Local VPN capture · no PC needed
features: DPS, healing and damage-received statistics with compact and expanded overlay modes.
Movable, resizable rankings with local-player highlighting and encounter history.
Processes supported BPSR traffic locally on your Android device.

screenshot.alt: BlueMeter Lite’s expanded Android overlay showing player damage, DPS and contribution above BPSR gameplay.
screenshot.caption: Expanded combat overlay on Android. Screenshot from the BlueMeter Lite repository.

steps: Download and install the APK from Releases. Choose arm64-v8a for most modern Android phones.
Open BlueMeter Lite, allow Display over other apps, then tap Start DPS Meter and approve the VPN prompt.
Open BPSR and enter combat. Move or resize the overlay to suit your screen.
requirements: Android with a supported BPSR client
Permission to display over other apps
Android’s local VPN permission
notes: Uses Android’s VPN slot for local capture, so another VPN cannot run at the same time. This is not a remote VPN service.
Combat data stays on your device. Protocol updates may require a new app version.

name: BPSR Android DPSMeter Relay
summary: Play BPSR on Android while a compatible Windows DPS meter reads the combat traffic.
description: Connect your phone to a PC combat meter over your home network. The Windows manager guides relay setup while you continue playing BPSR on Android.
note: PC and phone on the same trusted LAN
features: Guided phone setup with a QR profile for SFA (sing-box for Android).
Works with compatible meters that can parse BPSR traffic from the StarSEA process.
Separate Home, Details and Help views for everyday use and troubleshooting.
steps: Extract the full release ZIP and open BPSR Relay Manager.exe on your PC.
Choose the PC’s LAN address. Follow Prepare Relay, Allow Firewall and Start Phone Setup; import the profile in SFA and route BPSR only.
Start Relay on the PC, start SFA on the phone, then open BPSR. Select StarSEA in your PC DPS meter.
requirements: Windows PC and Android phone on the same trusted LAN
SFA on Android
A separate compatible PC DPS meter
Administrator approval for the Windows firewall rule
notes: This is a relay, not a combat meter. Choose StarSEA as the capture target, not BPSRMobileFront.
The phone-to-PC connection is authenticated but not encrypted. Keep it on a trusted private network and do not port-forward port 10808.

name: BPSR Custom PFP Lite
summary: Crop a custom profile picture or card and follow a guided capture-and-restore workflow.
description: Prepare a custom Blue Protocol: Star Resonance portrait or card with built-in cropping, numbered instructions and backup and restore controls.
features: Square portrait and card workflows with image cropping and repositioning.
Game-folder and picture-slot detection with manual fallbacks.
Install-specific backups and a guided restore step after capture.
steps: Download and extract the Windows ZIP, then open the app and select your BPSR folder.
Choose and crop your image. Follow the app’s numbered steps to save the portrait or card in BPSR.
Restore the original BPSR file when you finish. Keep the backup until the app confirms restoration.
requirements: Windows with BPSR installed
An image for your portrait or card
Write access to the game installation
notes: This method temporarily changes a BPSR client file. It is unofficial and is not guaranteed ban-safe.
If the game updates while a custom file is active, close BPSR and use the launcher’s Verify or Repair feature instead of forcing an old backup.

name: Portable Stream Kit
summary: Set up game capture, optional avatars and OBS scenes for Discord sharing or livestreaming.
description: A portable Windows launcher that brings game capture, frames and optional avatars into one setup. Share through Discord or stream with OBS.
features: Choose a game, frame, avatar and destination, then reuse your choices with Quick Launch.
Share the OBS Program Projector in Discord or connect a Twitch account in OBS.
Use a talking PNG, connect VTube Studio for Live2D, or stream without an avatar.
steps: Download StreamKit-win-x64.zip and extract the entire ZIP to a folder you can keep.
Open your game, run BPSRStreamKit.exe and choose your game, avatar, frame and destination.
Press the main start button. For Discord, share the OBS Program Projector window.
requirements: 64-bit Windows
The complete portable release folder
VTube Studio only if you want Live2D
TikTok LIVE/stream-key access only for TikTok streaming
notes: Keep OBS and its bundled plugins together. Update the bundle through a newer Stream Kit release.
VTube Studio is not included. Twitch sign-in happens in OBS; TikTok access depends on your account.

name: Malay TTS Bot
summary: Read Malay and Malaysian English messages aloud in Discord voice channels from your own Windows bot.
description: A self-hosted Discord text-to-speech bot for Malaysian Malay and Malaysian English. Runs on Windows with Gemini speech and a Google fallback, without a local AI model.
note: Your own Discord bot and API keys
features: Speaks eligible chat messages and announces the sender separately.
Voice selection, pronunciation controls and per-user text-to-speech opt-out.
A separate /ask command for short AI answers, plus status and privacy commands.
steps: Download the CLEAN ZIP and extract it into an empty C:\Malay-TTS-Bot folder.
Follow the README to configure your Discord bot and .env credentials. For an upgrade, restore only .env and data\guilds.json.
Run setup-clean.cmd as administrator, then start the Malay TTS Bot task. Join a voice channel and use /join.
requirements: Windows 11 PC that stays on while the bot runs
Your own Discord bot with Message Content Intent
Gemini API key for Gemini speech and /ask
Administrator access for Task Scheduler setup
notes: Setup registers a Windows SYSTEM task. Keep .env private and follow the README’s clean-install instructions.
Eligible message text is sent to speech providers, and sender names go to Google. Use /ttsprivacy for details and /ttsoptout for normal-chat opt-out.

name: builder-for-morphe
summary: A personal fork for configuring and building Morphe-patched Android APKs with GitHub Actions.
description: A personal fork of nvbangg/builder-for-morphe. Configure app builds, run the workflow and review the resulting APKs and build notes on GitHub.
features: Configure applications and patch sources in config.toml.
Run builds through GitHub Actions or follow the local build guide.
Review release assets and build notes for each app.
steps: Read the repository’s setup guide and configure the applications in config.toml.
Run the CI workflow in your fork and review the build output.
Set ALLOW_PUBLIC_APK_RELEASES=false to keep generated releases as drafts.
requirements: A GitHub fork with Actions enabled for your own builds
App and patch configuration
For local builds: Git, Python, uv and Java; see the setup guide
notes: APK availability varies by app and build. This is a community fork, not an official Morphe distribution.
Only publish third-party APKs when you have the right to redistribute them. Upstream credits and GPLv3 terms remain in the repository.
